body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package Angular 8.2.0-next.0 I wasn't able to compile an Ivy project using @angular@8.2.0-next.0 with Ivy enabled. It compiles using @angular 8.1.0 ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: Angular 8.1.0-next.3 ### Description I'm trying to compile an existing project (@nrwl recommended structure) using Ivy ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ## 🔥 Exception or Error
